disposition_reason: The registered Fig. 3 task admits an ordered estimation-agreement question, and the paper reports 23% average discrepancy between spike-only and voltage-derived irregularity. However, the exact percentage-error definition, empirical voltage reference pipeline, cohort/segment identities and conflicting 25/50 ms preprocessing are unresolved. The local prospective held-trial evaluator changes the historical evaluation and cannot certify a same-task paper win.

source_paper.title: A doubly stochastic renewal framework for partitioning spiking variability

evidence.locator: Results Sec7, Validation with intracellular voltage recordings, Par22–24 and Fig3; Methods Sec17, Intracellular voltage recordings, Par54–55
evidence.supports: Reports the 23% discrepancy, eight PV neurons from five mice, twenty 10-second segment estimates, voltage-to-rate procedure and inconsistent 25 ms caption versus 50 ms Results/Methods.

evidence.locator: Project description, Features and examples; pinned revision ba0490d064ea299c975e12bb94f3d922468f6b50
evidence.supports: Identifies the DSR simulator and estimator; example pathways use synthetic spike generation and do not supply the complete empirical Figure 3 workflow.
Provides the native spike-count-based irregularity estimator and defaults, which do not establish the original Figure 3 settings.
Maps operational intervals into real-time spike indices given rate; it is not the empirical membrane-voltage spline and real-to-operational validation pipeline.

target.description: Estimate spike-generation irregularity phi from spike trains alone and compare against voltage-derived operational-time ISI CV² for the paper’s Fig. 3 intracellular validation. The contribution phi/CVraw² is a biological quantity, not a score to maximize.

dataset.description: Pala/Petersen intracellular whole-cell recordings deposited at Zenodo 1304771, linked in the source paper’s Data availability; original membrane-potential data and spikes define the empirical validation. Synthetic DSR examples do not replace this dataset.

cohort.description: Source Methods specify eight qualifying layer-2/3 barrel-cortex PV neurons from five female mice, at least 20 Hz trial-average firing and at least ten 20-second trials. Exact cell/trial identities and inclusion mapping to the deposited matrix have not been recovered.

split.description: Figure 3 divides each recording into twenty 10-second segments and reports mean/SEM across segments; these are repeated estimates, not training/test partitions. Exact segment mapping is unrecovered. Introducing prospective held trials or segment selection creates an extension, not the original validation.

inputs.description: Candidate estimator receives source spike trains with source trial durations and boundaries. Independent membrane-voltage-derived irregularity defines the comparator; providing its estimated target or fitted voltage model as candidate input would change the spike-only task.

preprocessing.description: Source 20-kHz voltage processing detects −30 mV crossings, interpolates 3 ms before/5 ms after spikes, bins voltage/rate and fits a spline over voltage bins. Results and Methods specify 50 ms; Figure 3b specifies 25 ms. Spline, support, exact bin choice and segment use must be recovered from source-authorized evidence rather than selected for candidate advantage.

metric.description: The source reports an average discrepancy of 23% between spike-only and voltage-derived phi. The reviewed text does not resolve its denominator, signed/absolute operation and aggregation, so it is not yet an executable percentage-error score.

aggregation.description: Figure 3d averages twenty segment estimates per neuron and displays SEM; the eight-neuron summary is not twenty independent biological replicates per cell. The averaging rule producing 23% discrepancy remains unrecovered.

comparison.primary_metric: Source-reported average discrepancy between spike-only phi and voltage-derived phi; exact formula unresolved

published_baseline.description: The Results text explicitly reports 23% average discrepancy. This verifies the reported number only: its denominator/error aggregation and exact preprocessing remain unresolved, so 23 is not an admitted scoring threshold.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The pinned DSR estimator is available, but a source-equivalent empirical voltage-spline pipeline and complete Figure 3 cohort/segment mapping were not recovered. No model or fit was run.

minimum_effect.rationale: Justify a meaningful reduction in the recovered source discrepancy in relation to voltage-reference uncertainty and finite segment variability. No margin can be fixed while the percentage error itself is undefined.

uncertainty.method: Specify a paired candidate/author comparison with uncertainty that accounts for voltage-reference estimation and segments nested within neurons and mice. The paper’s segment SEM is not by itself a superiority test.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Five mice; eight neurons and twenty segments per neuron are nested measurements
uncertainty.rationale: The source biological sample is small and dependent; neither segments nor voltage time bins can supply invented independent replication.

paper_win_requires: Recover the source definition of 23% discrepancy and the exact empirical Fig. 3 pipeline, including source-authorized resolution of 25 versus 50 ms bins.
Match all eight original neurons, five mice and the twenty-segment mapping; independently calibrate the native author estimator and voltage-derived reference.
Freeze the spike-only candidate before final comparison and exceed a justified meaningful effect under a valid dependence-aware uncertainty rule.
Do not count smaller phi, larger phi/CVraw², synthetic-ground-truth performance, newly held-out trials or a new cohort as surpassing the original empirical paper task.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA estimate was verified. DSRP, its native rerun and any new estimator must remain distinct comparison records.

episode.improvement_loop: Inactive until exact source validation is recoverable. Any exploratory held-trial stability study must be labelled as an extension and cannot supply the original paper-win score.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze candidate estimator, source-equivalent preprocessing, cohort/segment manifest, reference construction, metric and budgets before comparison.
episode.final_evaluation: Use the recovered original empirical Fig. 3 validation and native author comparator; retain all paired cell-level results and dependence structure. A local natural-cubic held-trial evaluator is not assumed to be the source evaluator.
episode.baseline_policy: Keep the published 23% statement, a future exact author rerun and prospective held-trial results separate. The source physiological fractions 0.26 and 0.27 are not performance baselines.

blocking_issues: Exact mathematical definition and aggregation of reported 23% discrepancy are unresolved.
Source Results/Methods use 50 ms voltage/rate bins while Fig. 3b states 25 ms.
Empirical voltage-spline family/support details, source cohort identities and twenty-segment mapping have not been recovered.
Pinned time_rescaling.py is a spike-generation routine, not the empirical validation pipeline.
The local evaluator openly uses prospective held trials and natural-cubic policies; this is not native Figure 3 reconstruction.
No same-task working scorer, justified effect/uncertainty rule, candidate freeze or concrete episode budgets exist.

legacy.notes: Preserve the initial evaluator and native third-party estimator. Its generated controls and prospective held-trial outputs are calibration/extension evidence only; no authentic reference agreement or scientific improvement has been established.
